# Frame Studio

> Frame Studio (also known as Frame Web Studio) is a premium web design and development agency based in Rajkot, Gujarat, India. We design and engineer bespoke brand identities, custom websites, high-converting Shopify eCommerce stores, and scalable PHP web applications for startups and established brands in India and worldwide. Tagline: "Design, Develop, Deliver."

Frame Studio specialises in UI/UX design, custom web development, Shopify development, WordPress engineering, custom PHP web applications, technical SEO, and Generative Engine Optimization (GEO/AEO).

Brand colours: Bright Sky Blue #00A8FF, Vivid Blue #1F69F2, Pale Aqua #E1F1EF.
Brand typeface: DM Sans / Neue Haas Grotesk.

## Core Services
- [Shopify Development](https://framestudio.in/shopify-development): Bespoke Shopify and Shopify Plus eCommerce stores, custom Liquid theme design, app development, speed optimization, and secure platform migrations.
- [WordPress Development](https://framestudio.in/wordpress-development): High-performance custom WordPress theme architecture, WooCommerce development, headless CMS builds, and enterprise speed engineering.
- [PHP & Custom Web Apps](https://framestudio.in/php-development): Scalable, secure, custom PHP web systems, bespoke client portals, REST APIs, and database engineering.
- [eCommerce Development](https://framestudio.in/ecommerce-development): Full-cycle eCommerce platforms with streamlined checkout funnels, payment gateway integration, and high conversion rates.
- [Technical SEO & Digital Growth](https://framestudio.in/seo-services): Technical SEO audits, Core Web Vitals optimization, schema graph architecture, local SEO, and Generative Engine Optimization (GEO/AEO).
- [Website Maintenance](https://framestudio.in/website-maintenance): Proactive 24/7 security monitoring, backups, performance tuning, and technical support.
- [All Services](https://framestudio.in/services): Overview of Frame Studio design and engineering capabilities.
